notes: No RED msm8998-common repository is used.
Android 9 proprietary binaries still require LineageOS 22.2 build/runtime compatibility validation.
Android 9 source-owned HAL wrappers and explicit factory/debug executables are pruned on the Android 15 contract branch.
Stock init fragments are retained only when their service executable has an owner; device-owned init.qcom.rc/init.qcom.usb.rc are not duplicated by vendor.
RED .118 libsdm-disp-apis.so (32/64) is retained because the Leia display service DT_NEEDED graph requires it.
Android.bp shared_libs are generated from the retained .118 ELF DT_NEEDED graph.
317 of 336 proprietary ELF modules have check_elf_files enabled; the remaining 19 are explicit dependency-mapping exceptions tracked in ANDROID15_ELF_EXCEPTIONS.json.
